cluster_rules.PATTERN_CANDIDATE: spatial gate AND (frozen A or B SUPPORTED)
cluster_rules.LOCAL_CANDIDATE: spatial gate AND no A/B SUPPORTED AND frozen same-anchor short or near LOCAL_RISE_THEN_FALL with complete scope metadata
cluster_rules.REVIEW: spatial gate, neither candidate condition, and insufficient dynamic support or individual local/evidence observations
cluster_rules.NO_DETECTED_SIGNAL: spatial gate AND A/B NOT_OBSERVED with COMPLETE support AND all four short/near Rise/Fall NOT_OBSERVED with complete local support

frame_tie_break: state priority then smaller radius then cluster_id; never evidence score
empty_frame: official+strict+both teams observed+no mixed components at either radius -> NO_DETECTED_SIGNAL, spatial absence with temporal NOT_APPLICABLE; otherwise INSUFFICIENT
future_metadata: max dependency among all recorded candidate bases; REVIEW/NO_DETECTED_SIGNAL assessment budget 50; spatial failure/known empty frame 0
radius_overlap: frozen 3m-to-5m same-frame component family; same-node-set indicator; centroid separation diagnostic only

robustness.support: frozen Stage A 1778 Validation windows and Train donors; B.1/B.2 12x151 Validation support

note: Fixed before v2-3 implementation and Validation candidate counts. No new physical/score threshold; no tuning, labels, Test selection, episodes or possession. UNKNOWN is not negative truth.
